heroSection.description: A Java-focused full-stack developer who likes fast backends and clean, simple frontends. I build things that solve real problems, and I'm curious about the AI side of software too.

about.endingLine: Built to last, and easy to read when things change.

segments.title: How I Think
segments.label: Clarity
segments.text: I like code that is easy to understand and hard to break. Clear logic beats clever tricks, because simple code is the kind that stays reliable as it grows.

segments.title: How I Build
segments.label: Foundations
segments.text: Java and Spring Boot for the backend, React and Next.js for the frontend, and Terraform and Ansible for the infrastructure that runs it all. I don't stop at 'it works on my machine.'

segments.title: How I Learn
segments.label: Iteration
segments.text: I learn by building, breaking and fixing, and then working out why it broke. My projects are a little over-engineered on purpose, so they push me into problems I haven't solved yet.

segments.title: Where I'm Going
segments.label: Growth
segments.text: Better system design instincts, distributed systems, and AI tools that actually help people. And the gap between 'works on my machine' and 'works under load at 3am', which is the fun part.

about.paragraph: I'm a BCA graduate and full-stack developer. I started with Java and Spring Boot, then fell for React and TypeScript. I like building things, trying odd ideas and figuring out how all the pieces fit.
about.half: I like knowing why something works, not just that it does.

pillars.title: Understand first
pillars.text: I like figuring out the problem before jumping to a solution. Simple and clear usually wins.
pillars.backText: Sometimes I explain bugs to a duck. It helps more than you'd think.

pillars.title: A bit of everything
pillars.text: From APIs and databases to the buttons you click, I enjoy putting all the pieces together.
pillars.backText: Nothing beats the moment everything finally clicks into place.

pillars.title: Learn by doing
pillars.text: I try things, break things, and then figure out how to fix them.
pillars.backText: Every bug has a lesson in it. Some just take longer to say it out loud.

pillars.title: Always growing
pillars.text: There's always something new to learn, and I like keeping that curiosity switched on.
pillars.backText: AI, system design, and building things that keep working as more people show up.

mascotLines: I help Raunak find bugs. Sometimes.
Flip all four for a surprise!

skills.name: Java
skills.note: Where I started, and what I use for backends. It taught me to think in types, objects and structure.

skills.name: TypeScript
skills.note: Types catch my mistakes before users do. I reach for it on every frontend.

skills.name: JavaScript
skills.note: The language under it all. I like knowing what the tools are hiding from me.

skills.name: Python
skills.note: For small, sharp tools, like Calculate, a parser and evaluator with 100+ tests. Also my day-to-day at work, with Django.

skills.name: Spring Boot
skills.note: REST, WebSocket/STOMP, Security and JPA. My go-to backend, learned by building and breaking things.

skills.name: REST APIs
skills.note: Clear routes and predictable answers, plus JWT and Google sign-in.

skills.name: SQL
skills.note: MySQL in Hermes, and PostgreSQL with Flyway migrations in Pokeverse and AlgoForge.

skills.name: Redis
skills.note: Rate limiting, caching and live game state. Small tool, big difference.

skills.name: React
skills.note: Where I fell for the frontend. Small components that add up to whole screens.

skills.name: Next.js
skills.note: Routing, rendering and deployment in one place, so I can focus on the product.

skills.name: Tailwind CSS
skills.note: Utility classes keep spacing and colour consistent without leaving the markup.

skills.name: Framer Motion
skills.note: Springs and gestures that react to the visitor instead of looping on their own.

skills.name: Docker
skills.note: Multi-stage builds, non-root users and Compose for local development.

skills.name: Kubernetes (k3s)
skills.note: A two-VM k3s cluster on GCP with deployments, ingress and default-deny network policies.

skills.name: GitHub Actions
skills.note: A pipeline for Hermes with tests, a Trivy scan, a Docker build and a rollout. Written and waiting for its big moment.

skills.name: Terraform & Ansible
skills.note: Terraform builds the GCP network and VMs. Ansible sets up k3s, hardening and monitoring.

footer.note: Everything's open source. Take it, build better.

experience.summary: Backend and frontend work with Django REST and JavaScript: an internship management portal, plus a clinic dashboard for an existing healthcare platform.
points: Built an internship management portal with 5 dashboard modules, 10 data models and 10 REST endpoints.
Automated the intern journey end to end: shortlisting, approval, task assignment, attendance and feedback.
Built a clinic management dashboard for an existing healthcare platform, with 10 data models and 14 REST endpoints.
Wrote 130 automated backend tests (78 internship, 52 clinic) covering sign-in and core workflows.
Fixed 5 bugs in the doctor booking and review flow and shipped them through pull requests.
